variants.title: Ultrasonic interferometer: kerosene
variants.unknown: the velocity of ultrasound and the adiabatic compressibility of kerosene
variants.note: Kerosene is lighter and more compressible than water, so sound is slower and the wavelength shorter: 0.66 mm at 2 MHz.

source.title: Engineering ToolBox: speed of sound in kerosene 1324 m/s; density about 810 kg/m3 (CRC Handbook range 780-820)

variants.title: Ultrasonic interferometer: glycerol
variants.unknown: the velocity of ultrasound and the adiabatic compressibility of glycerol
variants.note: Glycerol is far less compressible than water: sound runs at 1904 m/s and the wavelength is 0.95 mm.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics: speed of sound in glycerol 1904 m/s at 20 °C; density 1.261 g/cm3
